formation: Variant of 悤. Depicts a line (匆) piercing a heart (心) (i.e. having an insightful understanding), conveying the meaning "insightful". now written as 聰. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

components.note: Depicts a line piercing. Represents having an insightful understanding in one's thoughts.
In ancient China, it was thought that the heart was the center of thought and reasoning.
